name: Star Athlete
clause: Blitz {3}{R}  /  Whenever ~ attacks, choose up to one target nonland permanent. Its controller may sacrifice it. If they don't, ~ deals 5 damage to that player.

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'choose-target'; target: TargetSpec; bind: 'that' } - a real target requirement (legal.ts ownTargetSpecs finds it through `target`) whose only effect is to bind the pick as `that` / `controller-of-that`
needs.semantics: The printed word 'target' can sit on a clause that no op acts on ('choose up to one target nonland permanent. Its controller may sacrifice it. If they don't, ...'). Today a requirement only exists as the `target` field of an op that DOES something to the pick, so such a trigger is unwritable: `unless-pays who:'controller-of-that'` has nowhere to get its binding from, and `bind from targets` creates no requirement.
needs.clause: Whenever ~ attacks, choose up to one target nonland permanent. Its controller may sacrifice it. If they don't, ~ deals 5 damage to that player.

needs.proposedSignature: AltCost id 'blitz': { id: 'blitz', label: 'blitz', cost: { mana: <printed> }, from: 'hand', grantsKeywords: ['haste'], grantsAbilities: [{ kind: 'triggered', event: { on: 'dies', self: true }, effects: [{ op: 'draw', amount: 1, who: 'you' }], text: 'When ~ dies, draw a card.' }], sacrificeAt: 'next-end-step' } + COVER_RULES.altCosts shape /^blitz (\{.+\})$/ + KEYWORD_EXPANSIONS.blitz
needs.semantics: If the spell was cast for its blitz cost, the permanent gains haste and 'When this creature dies, draw a card.', and is sacrificed at the beginning of the next end step. `dash` is already an AltCost id with the haste rider, so blitz is dash's shape with a sacrifice instead of a bounce plus a granted dies trigger.
